rawRetro.summary: Repairing the ticket desk feature's typecheck failures. The first repaired the lifecycle's comment repository typing; this round adds the missing paged-list response schema so ticketResponseSchemas satisfies SchemaChecks.

blockers.title: ticketComments repository typed with an id-only record makes createOne reject ticketId
blockers.symptom: tsconfig.server.json typecheck failed at server/lifecycles/ticket.ts:115, TS2769: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'ticketId' does not exist in type 'MutationValuesInput<CreateMutationValues<Partial<{ id: number; }>>>'.
blockers.rootCause: DatabaseConnection.repository<TRecord, TCreate = Partial<TRecord>, ...> derives its accepted create values from TRecord, but appendComment passed repository<{ id: number }>('ticketComments'), so only id was a valid create field.
blockers.resolution: Typed the repository as repository<TicketCommentRow>('ticketComments'), reusing the existing row type from server/ticket-types.ts, and imported it.

blockers.title: ticketResponseSchemas missing the page schema required by SchemaChecks
blockers.symptom: tsconfig.server.json typecheck failed at server/routes/schemas.ts:285, TS1360: ticketResponseSchemas does not satisfy SchemaChecks because property 'page' is missing.
blockers.rootCause: SchemaChecks declares page: z.ZodType<TicketListPage>, but ticketResponseSchemas defined only summary, detail, context, staff, user, workload, dashboard, comment, history and available, and no TicketListPage schema existed.
blockers.resolution: Added TicketListPageSchema (TicketPageMetaSchema extended with items: TicketSummary[]) and registered it as the page entry in ticketResponseSchemas, mirroring the service's listTickets return type.

evaluation.summary: 本次业务需求（IT 报修工单）未通过验收的反复失败点，是应用从未注册工单路由与页面：app/server/routes/index.ts 为空数组，/main/api/tickets:* 全 404、/main/tickets 回退，C01 在首轮及修复后仍在同一点失败，属应用交付缺口而非 NocoBase3 缺陷。框架侧生命周期、数据库/迁移、服务装配与通知插件都提供了与需求匹配的能力，Agent 也读到了对应 Skill 并写出了生命周期、迁移与通知调用；但 lifecycle.md §3 的 provider.start() 推荐写法未说明 recover() 依赖已迁移的日志表，照做会在未迁移作用域触发 RepositoryError 并中止启动（verify-6 两个测试失败），这是可行动的文档/易用性改进。评审受限于业务入口缺失与过程错误信号未逐条覆盖，通知运行时可靠性等维度保留 null。

modules.name: 生命周期状态机与后台任务

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/lifecycle.md
entrypoints: §2 记录表与两张日志表的迁移要求
§4 业务路由与 provider 装配

modules.scope: 工单状态流转、24 小时触发提醒、effect 的持久化与跨进程恢复；应用负责具体 transitions/guards/effects 与通知文案。
modules.limitations: 未能进入真实流转：应用路由/页面缺失，生命周期未被任何入口触发；24h 提醒与幂等恢复只有代码与日志证据。

requirements.need: 工单从提交、分派、处理、确认关闭到退回的状态流转，且并发流转不能同时提交。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 defineLifecycle 与 fire() 的事务+版本守卫、状态定义与 Effect；应用定义工单的 transitions/guards/effects。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 lifecycle.md §1-4：defineLifecycle 定义、createRepositoryLifecycleStore 绑定集合、provider 装配、迁移建表。
requirements.actualUsage: agent 在 app/server/lifecycles/ticket.ts 定义工单生命周期并由 TicketLifecycleProvider 装配（E23/E26），但从未注册任何路由/页面，流转没有触发入口。

requirements.need: 超过 24 小时未解决时提醒服务台（定时触发）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 trigger sweep + createLifecycleJobs 调度是基础职责；应用的 after=24h 触发器与提醒 effect 是业务规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 lifecycle.md §1 trigger + createLifecycleJobs({sweepEveryMs})；sweep 扫描 status/statusChangedAt。
requirements.actualUsage: provider 将 sweepEveryMs 设为 60_000 并计划 24h 触发器（E23），但应用在未完成迁移的作用域无法启动（E28），提醒链路未验证。

requirements.need: 进程重启后恢复遗留的 effect，保证通知不丢不重。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 recover()/reclaim() 负责在启动时接管上次未完成的 run；应用必须已创建并迁移两张日志表。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 lifecycle.md §3 在 provider.start() 中 await effectJobs().start()，其内部执行 recover()。
requirements.actualUsage: agent 照搬该模式（E23），结果在未应用迁移的 embedded 作用域启动时抛 COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND（E28），导致 app-server 测试失败。

requirementFit.reason: 工单状态机、定时提醒与跨进程恢复这三项需求都有直接对应的框架能力，且应用正确选用了 defineLifecycle/store/jobs/provider；扣分只因业务入口缺失导致需求未真正兑现。

usability.reason: 按指引即可装配状态机与 jobs，但 start() 内的 recover() 默认在启动时读日志集合，未给未迁移/嵌入式作用域留出容错，装配成功的前提容易被忽略。

agentFriendliness.reason: lifecycle.md 分节清晰、字段清单完整，agent 能据此写出生命周期与迁移；但“recover 需要日志表已存在”这一前置条件未写出，agent 照抄后踩坑。

design.reason: 公开抽象边界清楚：库不建表、不写路由，runtime/store/jobs 分离，provider 通过 token 共享单一 runtime；应用与框架职责划分合理。

reliability.reason: 实现确实将 effect run 持久化并在启动时恢复，但 recover() 对集合缺失直接抛 RepositoryError 并中止 provider start（E28），错误路径缺少降级或可操作提示。

modules.scope: 把应用自有 provider（lifecycle、ticket desk）接入启动顺序并解析服务 token；应用负责 provider 列表、token 与顺序。
modules.limitations: 未覆盖插件加载与路由注册的完整链路（应用 routes 为空）；启动失败的具体根因归属于生命周期模块。

requirements.need: 在应用启动顺序中装配自有 provider 并解析服务 token。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 ServiceProvider 生命周期、带阶段与回滚的 Registry、defineAppRuntime/resolveAppRuntime；应用声明 provider 数组与 token。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按模板 server/providers/index.ts 导出 provider 数组，在 register() 中 container.singleton(token)。
requirements.actualUsage: agent 正确添加 TicketLifecycleProvider/TicketDeskProvider（E25）；启动时因生命周期 recover 抛错，registry 记录 failed 并回滚（E28）。

requirements.need: 启动失败可诊断且不留半启动状态。
requirements.responsibility: 框架 Registry 在任一阶段失败时置 phase=failed、逆序 shutdown 已启动 provider，并把原始错误抛出。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 无需应用额外处理；错误会带 provider 名与阶段冒泡。
requirements.actualUsage: 日志栈显示 ServiceProviderRegistry.runPhase 抛出并触发回滚（E28），框架侧行为符合约定。

requirementFit.reason: provider 装配、token 注入与运行时组合完整覆盖需求，应用的 provider 模式一次就写对；失败来自生命周期内部而非装配层。

usability.reason: stage 顺序、失败回滚和 phase 断言让启动编排行为可预期，错误能定位到具体 provider；代价是任一步失败会整体中止，需要调用方保证前置条件。

agentFriendliness.reason: 模板与类型把 provider 装配方式固定下来，agent 能直接照做；但 provider.start() 的失败信息来自更深层 recover，单看装配层不易判断，需要读生命周期实现。

design.reason: 五阶段生命周期 + Registry 单一编排入口 + 服务 token 解耦，边界清晰，失败回滚是内建而非调用方补丁。

reliability.reason: Registry 对重复注册、阶段越界、启动失败和 shutdown 失败都有明确分支，并会把启动错误与关停错误合并抛 AggregateError。

findings.title: 生命周期库为工单流转、定时提醒与跨进程恢复提供了完整且边界清晰的基础能力
findings.detail: @nocobase/lifecycle 以事务+版本守卫的 fire()、持久化 effect run、可调度 trigger sweep 覆盖工单状态机需求，库明确“不建表、不写路由”，把 schema 与 HTTP 留给应用（E1/E6）。应用据此写出了 ticket.ts 与两条迁移（E26），说明该抽象能被 Agent 正确使用。
findings.impact: 在不缺业务入口的前提下，状态流转、并发保护与 24h 提醒无需应用自研底层机制。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现有分层；文档可补一个“从零接入检查表”，把迁移前置条件与验证方式集中列出。

findings.title: 应用只建表与 service，从未注册工单路由和页面，导致 C01 连续失败
findings.detail: app/server/routes/index.ts 导出空数组（E24），客户端也没有工单页面，因此 /main/tickets 与 /main/api/tickets:* 均不可用；而两条迁移只建了表。首轮 QA 明确记录“业务功能整体缺失、接口 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND”（E29）。后续 5 轮修复都在处理类型/迁移/测试错误，没有补齐路由与页面（E30）。
findings.impact: 业务需求除数据模型外全部未实现，是本次任务无法通过验收的直接原因；与框架能力无关。
findings.suggestedChange: 在实现阶段用“路由清单/页面清单”做出口检查：routes/index.ts 必须非空且每个业务用例有对应页面与 API；修复轮应优先处理 C01 的入口缺失而非局部类型错误。

diagnosis.trigger: 应用在 resources 预算内完成 service 与迁移后，未在 server/routes 注册任何路由，也未创建客户端工单页面。
diagnosis.expected: 应用注册 /api/tickets:* 等路由并渲染 /main/tickets 等页面，使 C01 可操作。
diagnosis.actual: routes/index.ts 为空数组（E24），QA 实测接口 404、业务路由回退（E29）。
diagnosis.acceptance: routes/index.ts 非空，/main/api/tickets:list 返回 200，/main/tickets 渲染工单列表并且 C01 通过。

findings.title: lifecycle.md §3 的 provider.start() 模式未说明 recover() 需要日志表已迁移
findings.detail: 指引在 §3 给出在 start() 中直接 await effectJobs().start() 的推荐写法，并注释其会“recover runs an earlier process left”（E7）；但实现里该调用会进入 recover()→takeBackStale()→listEffectRuns()（E2/E3），在日志表尚不存在时抛 COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND。应用照此模式后，两个 app-server 测试直接失败（E28）。

## 2. The migration

The library ships no migration. Write one self-contained migration under `database/main/migrations/` with every field spelled out, as [migrations and seeds](migrations.md) requires: never build it from the lifecycle definition.

The record table needs, besides its business fields:

- the state field, `status` by default, `string` not null;
- `statusChangedAt`, `datetimeTz` not null;
- `lifecycleVersion`, `integer` not null, default `0`;
- an index on `(status, statusChangedAt)`, which the trigger sweep reads.

The two log tables, created once for every lifecycle in the application:

- `lifecycleTransitions`: `id`, `lifecycle`, `recordId` (string), `transition`, `from` (nullable), `to`, `actorId`, `input` (json), `at` (`datetimeTz`), `version` (integer), `requestId` (nullable), `requestKey` (not null); unique indexes on `(lifecycle, recordId, version)` and `(lifecycle, recordId, requestKey)`, and an index on `(lifecycle, recordId, id)`.
- `lifecycleEffectRuns`: `id`, `transitionId`, `lifecycle`, `recordId` (string), `effect`, `stayBound` (boolean not null), `status`, `attempts` (default 0), `maxAttempts` (default 1), `result` (json), `error` (text), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `claimedAt`, `runAfter`, `continuation` (json, nullable), `continuationDueAt` and `continuationAbandonedAt` (`datetimeTz`, nullable); indexes on `(status, id)`, `(lifecycle, recordId, id)`, `continuationDueAt` and `continuationAbandonedAt`.

Different table names are passed to `createRepositoryLifecycleStore(db, { collections: { transitions, effectRuns } })`. Copy the column list from the installed package's README or the lifecycle example's migration (`packages/examples/app-plugin-lifecycle-example/database/migrations/` in the NocoBase repository) rather than guessing, and test it with `describeMigration()` as [testing](testing.md) describes.

# The database in a NocoBase 3 application

Most mistakes here are made before the first line of code, by putting a task at the wrong layer: changing schema from runtime code, reading records through the schema builder, or reimplementing relation writes on top of raw queries.

Six areas, in the order an application grows into them:

| Area                                            | Owns                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [Configuration](#1-configuration)               | which databases exist, and which dialect each one speaks     |
| [Migrations and seeds](#2-migrations-and-seeds) | schema history and install data                              |
| [Builder](#3-builder)                           | how a migration declares tables, fields and constraints      |
| [Repository and Query](#4-repository-and-query) | runtime reads and writes                                     |
| [Transactions](#5-transactions)                 | making several writes succeed or fail together               |
| [Collections](#6-collections)                   | what the database actually resolves to, for code and for you |

The exact parameters and return types are always the TypeScript declarations in `@nocobase/db`. This Skill decides which API to reach for, where the code belongs, and the boundaries the types cannot express.

## Where the code lives

```text
server/config/database.ts          connections and the default connection
config.yml                         per-environment overrides and credentials (gitignored)
database/<connection>/migrations   schema history for that connection
database/<connection>/seeds        install data for that connection
database/<connection>/collections  resolved Collection artifacts
server/routes/, server/providers   runtime reads and writes
```

`<connection>` is a connection name from `server/config/database.ts`, so the default connection's migrations are in `database/main/migrations/`. Adding a connection means adding its directory alongside and keeping `database/tsconfig.json` in place, so migrations and seeds are typechecked and linted as server source.

Runtime code never changes schema, and a migration never imports runtime code. That split is what these directories encode.

| `config.yml`                | Environment overrides including credentials — gitignored              |
| `config.example.yml`        | The documented structure and credential placeholders; keep it in step |

evidence.excerpt:
## Migrations change incrementally

A migration that has been merged is history. Every installation that already ran it recorded it as executed and will never run it again, so editing it splits installations in two: those that ran the old version keep the schema it produced, and fresh ones get the schema the new version produces. Nothing reconciles the two, and the only symptom is a checksum warning that `pnpm nocobase db repair` silences without changing the schema.

So every schema change after a merge is a new migration, including a fix to a migration that turned out wrong:

- Leave the merged file untouched: not its operations, its `down`, its name, its filename, its formatting or its comments. Even a reformat changes the checksum every installation recorded and warns each of them.
- Name the new migration so it sorts after the one it corrects. Migrations run in name order across the application and every plugin.
- Write it to take an installation from what the earlier migrations left behind to the target, so it holds both on an installation that ran the earlier migrations long ago and on a fresh one that runs everything in order.
- Spell out the change explicitly with `builder.alterCollection`, field, index or constraint operations, and move existing rows with set-based `query` statements where the change needs it.
- Test the upgrade path with `describeMigration()`: it applies the earlier migrations first, then this one.

Check `git log -- <file>` when unsure whether a migration is merged. The same rule holds for migrations a plugin ships: a released plugin's migrations reach every application that installs it, so a plugin corrects one the same way.

Register the core Server plugin before the in-app and built-in Provider plugins. Register their Client plugins for the desired logs and inbox UI. Apply plugin migrations. Register end-user notification plugins only when the product needs them.

Delivery tasks run on the application's jobs service (`JobExecutorServiceProvider` from `@nocobase/app-server/jobs`) under the `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification` scope; the plugin sets its executor up on start and shuts it down with the application. `notification.jobs` names the `jobs` configuration they run on; left out, they follow `jobs.default`, and a name that `jobs` does not define stops the application from starting. The memory adapter serves one process, so run more than one instance on a `redis` jobs configuration. Deliveries are persisted before they are submitted, so the reconciler resubmits any task a stopped process lost.

`notification.channels` is a name-to-configuration map. Keys must be non-empty trimmed names of at most 100 characters. Each entry has a `provider`, optional `enabled` (default true), and flat Provider-specific settings. Duplicate YAML keys are configuration errors. Provider identifiers are globally unique; the Provider definition supplies the message type. `name`, `type`, and `providers` are not Channel configuration fields.

```yaml
notification:
  channels:
    system-email:
      provider: smtp
      host: smtp.example.com
      port: 587
      auth: { user: '${SMTP_USER}', pass: '${SMTP_PASSWORD}' }
      from: notifications@example.com
    marketing-email:
      provider: resend
      apiKey=[REDACTED]}'
      from: marketing@example.com
    ops-feishu:
      provider: feishu-webhook
      webhookUrl: '${FEISHU_WEBHOOK_URL}'
    inbox:
      provider: in-app

  retry:
    maxAttempts: 1
    intervalMs: 5000
```

`notification.retry.maxAttempts` is the maximum number of automatic attempts for one Delivery, including the first attempt; it defaults to `1`, so automatic retries are disabled by default. `notification.retry.intervalMs` is the fixed wait between automatic attempts and defaults to `5000` milliseconds. A validated Provider `Retry-After` hint takes precedence over this interval.

The application owns secret interpolation. SMTP supports `host`, `port`, `secure`, `auth`, `from`, and `replyTo`; Resend uses `apiKey`, `from`, and optional `replyTo`. Webhook Providers use `webhookUrl` and optional signing `secret`. Feishu requires HTTPS on `open.feishu.cn` or `open.larksuite.com`; DingTalk requires HTTPS on `oapi.dingtalk.com`. Redirects are rejected. Keep credentials out of public descriptors and logs.

Keep Channel names and Provider identifiers stable while deliveries remain pending or retryable. Removing, disabling, or changing a Channel's Provider prevents the old Delivery from being retried elsewhere.

## Registration without plugin discovery

Custom hosts can create a registry, register Channel and Provider definitions, create one manager with the host database/queue/logger, then mount routes and own lifecycle. Register definitions before `start()` or the first `send()` for that Channel.

The core `manager.router` exposes `GET /logs` and `GET /logs/{logId}` without adding authentication itself. The plugin's normal route contribution mounts it at `/api/notifications` with required authentication, authorization middleware, and `page:notification.logs` `access` checks. Custom hosts must provide equivalent protection. `GET /api/notifications/logs` is cursor-paged, newest first: it takes `pageSize` (1 to 100, default 20) and `pageToken`, and answers `{ data, meta }`; pass `meta.nextPageToken` back unchanged as `pageToken` until it is absent. An unknown log id is `404` with reason `NOTIFICATION_LOG_NOT_FOUND`.

For a custom host, register the exported `NOTIFICATION_NAMESPACE` / `notificationServerLocales` and `IN_APP_NOTIFICATION_NAMESPACE` / `inAppNotificationServerLocales` pairs with the host `I18nRuntime`, initialize it, then mount its request i18n middleware before the core logs and in-app routers. Every failure is the application's standard error body, `{ error: { code, status, reason, domain, message, localizedMessage?, fieldViolations?, metadata?, requestId } }`, with domain `notifications` for this plugin and `notificationInApp` for the inbox. Clients branch on `reason` (`ApiClientError.reason` in the browser), never on `message`; `localizedMessage.message` is the text already translated into the request's locale, and `metadata` carries the translation parameters such as a field `name`. Authentication middleware retains its owning plugin's error contract.

The in-app router must derive the current user from trusted authentication state. Never accept a client-supplied user id as the current identity. Its write endpoints use a CSRF token/cookie pair.

The inbox is owned by `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app` and lives under `/api/notificationInApp`. List the current user's messages with `GET /api/notificationInApp/messages`. `pageSize` must be an integer from 1 through 100 (default 20). When `meta.nextPageToken` is present, pass that opaque value back as `pageToken`; do not parse, edit, or manufacture tokens. Writes are custom methods, `POST /api/notificationInApp/messages/{messageId}/markRead`, `.../markUnread` and `POST /api/notificationInApp/messages/markAllRead`, plus `DELETE /api/notificationInApp/messages/{messageId}`; see that plugin's Skill for the CSRF token they require.

State is saved on close and also periodically while the browser is open (at most once per `AGENT_BROWSER_AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_MS`, default 30000), so state survives even if the user closes the browser window by hand.

```bash

agent-browser snapshot -i --json > page.json

# Targeted extraction with refs
agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser get text @e5
agent-browser get attr @e10 href

# Arbitrary shape via JavaScript

const rows = document.querySelectorAll("table tbody tr");
Array.from(rows).map(r => ({

  price: r.cells[1].innerText,
}));

```

Prefer `eval --stdin` (heredoc) or `eval -b <base64>` for any JS with quotes or special characters. Inline `agent-browser eval "..."` works only for simple expressions.

```bash
agent-browser screenshot                        # temp path, printed on stdout
agent-browser screenshot page.png               # specific path
agent-browser screenshot --full full.png        # full scroll height
agent-browser screenshot --annotate map.png     # numbered labels + legend keyed to snapshot refs
```

`--annotate` is designed for multimodal models: each label `[N]` maps to ref `@eN`.
